description: This file contains the implementation of OrleansRelationalDownloadStream, a custom Stream class for chunked reading from a database using ADO.NET, specifically for providers that do not natively support GetStream(int). It manages reading bytes from a DbDataReader, supports asynchronous read operations, and handles stream position and length.

classes.name: OrleansRelationalDownloadStream
classes.description: A custom Stream implementation for chunked reading from a database via DbDataReader, supporting asynchronous operations and handling providers that lack native GetStream support.

methods.name: OrleansRelationalDownloadStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream with a DbDataReader and column ordinal, determining total bytes.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads bytes from the database stream into a buffer synchronously.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads bytes from the database stream into a buffer.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Copies data asynchronously from this stream to a destination stream using a buffer.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the reader and cleans up resources.
